verdict.rationale: Codex supports MCP client connections to third-party tools/servers and plugins (codex-docs-16, codex-docs-20, codex-docs-26), plus native integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Linear and Slack (codex-docs-1, codex-docs-2), letting an eng-lead pull external partner tooling into workflows. However, evidence centers on tool/data connectors rather than integrating actual third-party 'partner-built agent apps' (e.g., agent marketplaces or partner-built autonomous agents), and the only agent-delegation reference (codex-docs-13) is to Codex's own internal specialized agents, not external partners. Missing for 10: evidence of a partner/agent marketplace or directory, concrete examples of integrating externally-built agent apps (not just data/tool connectors), and independent confirmation these integrations work smoothly in practice.
